title: Bisikan Absurd di Kursi Baris Tengah
theme: Menjelajahi keanehan interaksi manusia dan absurditas dalam rutinitas harian, menemukan komedi terselubung dalam observasi diam.

cover.prompt: An atmospheric view inside an old, grand cinema auditorium. Rows of vintage, worn velvet seats, illuminated by the soft, gentle glow reflecting from a large, unlit screen. Focus on a single empty seat, perhaps Row G, Seat 7, slightly off-center. The composition emphasizes a feeling of peaceful solitude and quiet contemplation. Use cinematic framing with a shallow depth of field and warm, inviting ambient lighting.
cover.style: Lo-fi aesthetic, vintage film grain, nostalgic feel, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A writer seeking inspiration in a nearly empty old cinema finds herself observing the absurd and humorous behaviors of a few eccentric audience members, leading to an introspective and cynical realization that true inspiration often comes from the quiet chaos of human interaction.
